email_body:
Dear STRIDE team,

I am writing to apply for the Content & Social Media Manager position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, GEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to own STRIDE's organic content engine and help build a recognizable brand voice across Europe.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and write keyword-targeted content that drives organic traffic. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, applying structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to turn a story into a multi-channel content strategy, from website copy to social media integration.

I am particularly drawn to STRIDE's commitment to quality over volume and the use of AI to scale content without losing authenticity. I am eager to bring my skills in content strategy, social media management, and performance analysis to your team.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to STRIDE's growth.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear STRIDE team,

I am excited to apply for the Content & Social Media Manager role at STRIDE. Your mission to create a recognizable voice and a content operation driven by quality and performance resonates deeply with my own approach to digital marketing.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write blog content that grows organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. This hands-on experience has taught me how to turn technical insights into compelling content that performs.

My project mirook.com is a prime example of my ability to own a content engine end-to-end. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data and entity optimization for AI search visibility, and integrated social media channels. I also ran iterative SEO/GEO audits, measurably improving the site's search health. This project demonstrates my skills in content strategy, copywriting, and performance analysis—all essential for this role.

I am particularly drawn to STRIDE's emphasis on using AI to scale content without sacrificing quality. I am proficient with AI-assisted tools and understand how to edit and enrich AI-generated content to maintain a human, authentic voice. I am also comfortable working with satellite teams and adapting content for local markets while preserving brand consistency.

With my background in SEO, content creation, and web development, I am confident I can help STRIDE tell its stories effectively across channels and drive measurable results. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
